name: @opencraw/core

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "for (const f of ['dist/index.esm.js', 'dist/src/index.d.ts']) if (!require('node:fs').existsSync(f)) { console.error('@opencraw/core: ' + f + ' is missing, so this publish would ship no code: build first (0.1.47 went out like that)'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.esm.js --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationDir dist/src --tsBuildInfoFile dist/src/tsconfig.lib.tsbuildinfo && node ../../declaration-specifiers.mjs dist/src

description: Recipe-driven crawler engine: JSON input recipes (Playwright browser or HTTP API steps) mapped through transforms to JSON output schemas.
